title: SOC-Ready Application Security Event
description: Canonical high-value, low-noise security audit event contract for custom software vendors, aligned to OWASP Logging Vocabulary / ASVS and ACSC ISM System Monitoring.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the canonical security event schema.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp with trailing Z (ACSC ISM-0988 accurate/consistent time source).

stream.description: Explicit stream marker separating SOC SIEM security events from operational/debug telemetry.

event.description: OWASP Logging Vocabulary-aligned event identifier (e.g., authn_login_fail, authz_fail, priv_role_assigned).

category.description: High-level security domain mapped to ECS event.category / OCSF class.

severity.description: Security severity. DEBUG/TRACE are intentionally excluded from the SIEM security stream.

component.description: Sub-service or module emitting the event (e.g., auth-api, export-worker).

environment.description: Deployment environment so the SOC can separate production alerts.

version.description: Deployed application release or build identifier.

host.description: Hostname, pod name, or instance ID (ACSC ISM-0585 ICT equipment involved).

id.description: Immutable principal identifier (e.g., Entra OID, UUID, service principal ID). Never a raw password or token.

username.description: Optional non-secret login identifier or pseudonymous handle (ensure alignment with agency privacy rules).

roles.description: Effective roles or privilege tier at event time.

tenant_id.description: Agency, organisation, or tenant identifier for multi-tenant SaaS/custom apps.

session_id_hash.description: Salted or truncated SHA-256 hash of session identifier for correlation without exposing the raw token.

impersonated_by.description: Actor ID of administrator/support user when acting on behalf of another user.

ip.description: True client IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) derived from trusted proxy headers or socket.

geo_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code if enriched at edge.

type.description: Resource type (e.g., user, role, document, api_key, config, export, record).

id.description: Identifier of the targeted resource or filename (ACSC ISM-0585).

name.description: Sanitised resource name or path (never containing secrets or sensitive PII).

classification.description: Data sensitivity classification (supports Australian PSPF & enterprise labels).

route.description: Parameterised route template (e.g., /api/v1/cases/{id}) without query secrets.

correlation_id.description: Request/trace correlation ID (e.g., W3C traceparent trace-id or UUID) to join gateway, app, and DB logs.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code (e.g., invalid_credentials, mfa_required, missing_role, rate_limit_exceeded).

message.description: Concise, human-readable single-line description of what happened (ACSC ISM-0585).

details.description: Bounded, structured event-specific attributes (e.g., changed field names, record_count, mfa_method, retry_count). Must never contain secrets or unredacted PII.
